avoid_when: Using contracts declarations as evidence that a codec, importer, native runtime or hosted agent dispatcher exists.
Duplicating IAMScene file-format registration, actual geometry operations, or tenant/project persistence in the contracts package.
name: @inneranimalmedia/agentsam-contracts
purpose: Portable contracts for AgentSam operations, tools, authority, providers, workspaces, and scene-format capability/round-trip receipts; does not implement codecs, renderers, authorization or asset storage.
use_when: Type-checking cross-application scene-format operation availability and loss-aware round-trip receipts without importing a scene engine.
Sharing AgentSam tool, agent, event, workspace, context and resource-scope contracts across independently packaged products.
Representing loose file, asset, scene and optional project references without treating project membership as an authorization grant.
